theoretical_scope.global_marginal_statement: With the target-fitted score function fixed from train only, the global calibration order statistic retains its marginal finite-sample interpretation under case exchangeability.

decision.finding: This post-hoc experiment tests a new observable signal family; it is not an independent confirmation.
limitations: The signal family was designed after earlier evaluations were visible.
All labels are public QA evidence ids rather than flood-domain expert judgments.
Global calibration does not establish conditional subgroup guarantees.
No result from reused data authorizes CANARY or DEFAULT.
